summary: Implemented the 630 Lambda transform. Added `Lambda` (array) in monai/transforms/utility/array.py, which wraps a user callable and raises TypeError if it is not callable. Added `Lambdad` (dictionary) in monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, which applies one callable to all keys or one callable per key (ValueError on length mismatch), plus aliases LambdaD/LambdaDict. Added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst and new tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Per instructions, nothing was run or committed; verification was by reading only.
